sections.voiceover: Researchers at Harvard University publish daily insights on integrative strategies. M. H. Bazerman studies multi-issue agendas. Which tactics manage the negotiator's dilemma across volume 21?
You risk leaving value on the table when dividing a fixed pie.
M. H. Bazerman uncovers shared and differing interests simultaneously. Issue 4 outlines how simultaneous offers create and claim value. Both parties capture maximum benefit.
Visit the Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School to apply these Harvard tactics.
